- `hmh07-lua-follow4:110` (original lines 204-206, 208-210): Builds the heal-cooldown HUD. State-condition closures, powerRatio/shader links, input-source updates and close hook are conditional callbacks. Flare/pulse Full states test powerRatio==1; the KBM ability prompt is true only on the explicit ability branch. Parent state/ammo callbacks can play Pulse when PowerBased and ShouldPulseNewAmmo. The tail registers close, conditionally calls PostLoadFunc and returns. Creates self via LUI.UIElement.new, LED via LUI.UIImage.new, AmmoWidgetAbilityContainer via CoD.AmmoWidget_AbilityContainer.new, AmmoWidgetMPAbilityFlare via CoD.AmmoWidgetMP_Ability_Flare.new, BackingFillAnim via LUI.UIImage.new, FullBackingDeployed via LUI.UIImage.new, AbilityPulse via CoD.AmmoWidgetMP_Ability_Flash.new, Box via LUI.UIImage.new, PowerBasedImageAvailable via LUI.UIImage.new, PowerBasedImageUnavailable via LUI.UIImage.new, NotAvailable via CoD.AmmoWidget_EquipmentEmpty.new, Line via LUI.UIImage.new, HeroAbilityUseString via CoD.ControllerDependent_TextBox.new, GlowRing via LUI.UIImage.new, FlareBack via LUI.UIImage.new, BountyHealthCount via CoD.BountyHunterHealthCount.new, CodCasterLoadoutSelection via CoD.CodCasterLoadoutSelectionHeal.new. Stores state predicates Full, Full, Hidden, KeyboardAndMouse, KeyboardAndMouseAbility, KeyboardAndMouseUltimate, KeyboardAndMouseScoreStreak, Hidden, InUse, Deployed, BountyEmpty, PowerBasedEmptyCharging, PowerBasedCharging, PowerBased; their body effects require state-system evaluation.

- `hmh07-lua:189` (original lines 204-204, 204-206, 208-208, 208-210): AmmoWidgetWZContainer directly constructs this ability-item widget and overrides use-string labels/model afterward. Builds icon/glow, controller prompts, cycle prompt, hold-to-activate variants, LED and stack count. Prompt HiddenPreference delegates Warzone hide settings; Hidden checks killcam/play-of-match/team-spectator; the non-WZ KBM ability/ultimate/streak variants are explicitly AlwaysFalse, while KeyboardAndMouseAbilityWZ allows mouse/keyboard. Cycle Visible requires profile warzoneCycleItems=1 and quick inventory open, with Hidden AlwaysTrue fallback. Settings/storage/inventory/input notifications reevaluate those states. Stack text binds equipmentStackCount; Invisible when count<1. Self Hidden=count<1; InUse=state inuse; Deployed=AlwaysFalse; EmptyCharging=charging with powerRatio0; Charging=charging; PowerBased=not hidden. powerRatio/state/count updates reevaluate self. Through the named setState override, pulse only if ShouldPulseNewAmmo and current PowerBased; ammo link repeats that predicate, id link fades in only for cycle-items+quick inventory. PC alpha helper runs immediately and on powerRatio/hideRadiationHold. PreLoadFunc is called near the END, after close hook/subscriptions; IsPC hides the gamepad hold child. Return self. Frozen span contains no full class clips/close body outside it; preserve them as precise dependencies, not assumed implementation. Native event delivery, inventory production and settings remain external.

- `hmh07-lua:019` (original lines 208-210): Starts PC sticky registration and pre-sets menu chat, constructs ChatClient, binds ChatGlobal and sets default focus to ChatClient. Hidden means ChatClientShow is false; StartMenu is true when HUD is not visible, otherwise follows UI-active bit. Visibility subscriptions revalidate. It registers the close hook, runs optional PostLoadFunc and finishes sticky setup. Construction on a shared WZ HUD does not prove PS4 chat support.

- `hmh07-lua-follow1:033` (original lines 208-210, 208-210): Creates Hud_MP_Codcaster menu, safe-area child and MP HUD components, current-weapon damage model binding, score notifications and spectator/profile state consumers. On score_event it prioritizes bounty score, then combat-efficiency score when spawn selection is inactive, then normal score. Objective ShowNotification predicates are AlwaysFalse here. HideAllButScoreboard is killcam/final/round/stage visibility union; SpeedBoost uses exact gadget id/state; HideForCodCaster requires spectator profile. X input is blocked only while AreXButtonPressesDisallowed; player_spawned outside draft disallows X400ms. Optional postload then self return; effective HMH thrust/visibility data remains unknown.

Otherwise shows it and computes the displayed fraction from (viewHeight - totalYDistance) / viewHeight; top-anchored and bottom-anchored branches set different top/bottom percentages from currentYOffset. No zero-height guard is shown. Uses 500/50 scroll-repeat values and defaults an absent target to the root. Interactive mode enables up/down mouse buttons and registers bar press/release/lose-focus/capture-lost/close/drag handlers plus background paging. Press asserts unlocked focus, captures the mouse and saves contact offsets. Release/lose-focus/close release capture and clear state; capture-lost clears state. Drag clamps normalized Y, optionally reverses it and scrolls. The disabled branch keeps bar/background unfocusable on updates. Wheel-down/up callbacks still register after either branch, scroll by opposite wheelScrollUnit values and return true; their prompt callbacks return false. When ContextualMenu exists, removes matching focusable paths during an ipairs traversal, closes and clears the contextual menu, then attaches a one-unit timer that force-notifies FreeCursor.position. In-place removals have the literal Lua traversal behavior; no compensation is invented.

- `hmh07-lua-follow1:005` (original lines 208-210, 208-210): The constructor requests persistent seenWZInGameAAR initialization only when its child handle is falsey, and prepares merit reward models with false, then requests WZAAR_Containers and an empty focus target. Visible requires the aarVisible model value to be literal true; the registered model subscription requests reevaluation only when delivered. The registered setState callback, when delivered and its Visible predicate succeeds, requests LockInputHUD(self,true), MenuHidesFreeCursor(menu,delivered controller), then SetupMeritModels(true). MenuHidesFreeCursor does work only when usingfreecursor is truthy: it handles a prior delayed timer, may register close/unhide, and if hidFreeCursor is falsey sets that flag and either clears truthy ignoreNextMenuHides or requests hidden:get()+1. Actual cursor/native result is unknown. The DefaultState branch requests LockInputHUD(false) and lose focus. It registers close, may request PostLoadFunc, and returns only if reached. No independent close/unlock-on-error guarantee, callback delivery/order, persistent seen/AAR/backend provenance or runtime behavior is established.

- `hmh07-lua:184` (original lines 208-208, 208-210): ui/main.lua1132..1165 builds common Hud unless existing/excluded gametype, then chooses WZ suffix for CoD.isWarzone OR gametype warzone (Campaign and CODFU/DOA overrides retained), and only when no T7HudMenuGameMode invokes Hud_WZ through dynamic factory unless non-WZ codcaster special case applies. Original effective flags/build remain conditional. Constructor initializes aarVisible/aarViewed only if unset, disabling automatic buttons only on PC, creates safe-area/ready/damage/chat/objective/results/scoreboard/hint/wheel/PC widgets. ReadyEvents scriptNotify dispatches hero_weapon_received/killstreak_received/levelup helpers; objective ShowNotification defaults are AlwaysFalse. MPHintText nonempty predicate and nonnil text link make this shared MP-named child usable on WZ. Sprays Visible requires held button plus no prematch-hide/last-stand/inventory/multi-pickup/remote/vehicle/demo/dead/round-end/scoreboard/spectator exclusions; Callouts similarly requires pressed+enabled and no theater/prematch/inventory/last-stand/dead/round-end/scoreboard/spectator exclusion. All corresponding model/input links reevaluate state, never produce gameplay input by themselves. Self states: HideAllButScoreboard=stage_ended; SpeedBoost=gadget_speed_burst plus gadget2 inuse; HideForCodCaster=caster with profile playerhud1. Circle/back hides scoreboard only through predicates and blocks the game event. Up opens quick inventory only with HUD weapon visibility, allowed inventory, no ended/demo/dead/scoreboard/spectating/UI/laststand/vehicle-hide/disable-setting; Down closes with its separate narrower gate. Weapon-next/prev/primary/secondary require Warzone, full inventory open and no demo. LB/RB/triggers and Cross prioritize health/equipment cycle actions when quick inventory open/profile cycle-items1/button-mapping agrees; they block the game event. Cross then has PC-gamepad deathcam fallback. PC-only spectate/deathcam/AAR/report branches retain exact additional conditions; if IsPC=false they do not execute, without excluding unconditional PC-looking child construction. CanUseQuickInventory notification closes quick inventory only if now disallowed and already open; character_unlock_update dispatches UpdateUnlockQuestState. menu_loaded processed, linked __onClose hook registered, captured f0_local0 postload invoked if present. PC final setup adds region checks/sizing; console final setup disables keyboard navigation and adds WZ armblade reticles; both setup grenade warnings/custom focus/cursor rules. Return self. Full exact callbacks/labels/branch ordering are in trace; unselected class clips/reset/close and external helper bodies are dependencies only, with no claim of original event delivery, network menu response or real execution.
